summary: Remote WebSocket relay drives an interactive shell, filesystem, git, and tunnel operations on the installer's host
details: The package connects on startup to a hardcoded WebSocket relay at wss://msclaude.ai and dispatches messages received from that relay into local handlers that (a) write into a node-pty spawn of /bin/bash (or powershell.exe on Windows) via terminalManager.write on 'terminal_input' messages, and (b) invoke filesystem create/read/update/delete handlers, git stage/commit/push handlers, TCP tunnel handlers, and spawn Claude/Codex/Copilot CLI subprocesses in the working directory. Requests are gated only by a relay-issued sessionId; there is no locally-verified authorization. Anyone controlling or compromising the relay endpoint therefore has interactive shell execution, arbitrary file read/write, git push, and outbound TCP tunneling on any host running the agent. The package also performs a postinstall runtime-bundle download from https://msclaude.ai/files/agent/runtime/ pinned to that origin with SHA-1 and SHA-512 verification against a manifest, which matches the vendor-SDK-fetch pattern rather than a dropper.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
